title: Dungeon Workers' Alliance
kicker: A half-legend of organized labor, old route pins, and workers who remember the dungeon never cleared itself.
hook: Dungeon Workers' Alliance: The Dungeon Workers' Alliance is an old labor name that survives in brass pins, hand-copied maps, and tired defiance. Slogan: Nobody clears the dungeon alone.

blocks.label: Public Face
blocks.body: A half-legend of organized labor, old route pins, and workers who remember the dungeon never cleared itself.

blocks.label: How To Deal
blocks.body: The Alliance feels less like a banner and more like a promise passed hand to hand. A dull brass pin in a collar, a copied route map with names by the dangerous bends, a worker who says 'we' when the company file says 'incident.'

affordances: Compare their slogan to what they actually do in the scene.
